failures.criterion: Spec item 1: a document's open Referenced by panel follows an edit of a comment on that document (main does this)
failures.evidence: Red test 'document panel: an edit of a comment on a project document shows its new text in the document's open Referenced by panel within 2 s' in packages/dispatch/e2e/refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (commit e183b08f238c). It fails at head on chromium and iphone: the panel still reads 'Owned item · CORE just now Original remark' after alice's own edit from another tab. It passes at main b08a56bc (the base this branch merged). Cause found by reading: event-refresh.ts appendDocumentPanel (226-235) handles ask.opened, ask.anchor_refreshed, comment.created, comment.answered and comment.anchor_refreshed, but not comment.edited or ask.edited. The server names no structural (owned_by or anchored_to) target in references_changed. Main refreshed every ['references'] panel on comment.edited and ask.edited. Command: cd packages/dispatch && DATABASE_URL=<own db> bunx playwright test --config e2e/playwright.config.ts --project=chromium --project=iphone e2e/refresh-freshness.e2e.ts -g 'edit of a comment'.

failures.criterion: Spec item 1 (an event that changes nothing the page shows fetches nothing) and the issue's goal: a document version that cites more than 20 targets must not make every open tab re-read its issue detail, asks and Inbox
failures.evidence: Red test 'budget: a document in another project citing 25 documents reads no issue detail, Inbox or ask list for an open issue page' in refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (e183b08f238c). It fails at head on chromium and iphone. An issue page in CORE is open, and bob creates one document in OTHER whose single paragraph cites 25 OTHER documents. Within 2.5 s the page reads GET /api/v1/issues/CORE-1, /api/v1/issues/CORE-1/asks twice, and /api/v1/inbox. Cause found by reading: round 2 counts artifact and block entries toward the server's 20-target cap on references_changed (refs/refs.go), so such a write sets references_changed_truncated. On a truncated event, event-refresh.ts changedReferenceTargets refreshes ['issue'], ['asks'], ['ask-thread'], ['artifact'], the Inbox and every ['references','to'] in every tab. A spec or index whose one block lists 21 or more links, which agents rewrite often, then brings back the fan-out this issue removes. The same holds for 21 or more issue or ask links, as it did in round 1.

failures.criterion: Plan decision 4 (user_state.updated must not broadcast which issue each person reads), applied to the new person-scoped snooze event that the architect's ruling asked for
failures.evidence: Red test 'snooze: another person's event stream carries nothing that names the ask alice snoozed' in refresh-freshness.e2e.ts (e183b08f238c). It fails at head on chromium and iphone: bob's own browser session replays GET /api/v1/events?since=0 and receives alice's user_state.updated frame, which carries her login, ask_id of the ask she snoozed, changed ['snoozed'], and her pinned, last_read_seq and dismissed state for that ask's issue. Every signed-in person and agent gets the frame: the stream has no per-viewer filter (api/events.go). ask_snooze.go askSnoozeEvent builds it. Either the payload must name no ask and no issue state (so the writer's tabs refresh the whole Inbox), or the stream must keep the frame from everyone but the writer. The architect decides which.

failures.criterion: Architect's Retry-After addition: a retry that honours Retry-After must not leave a page read waiting without bound
failures.evidence: Red unit test 'a read refused with a Retry-After longer than a minute still retries within a minute' in packages/dispatch/web/src/api/query-client.test.ts (commit e173a17b4c88). It fails at head: queryRetryDelay returns 86400000 for Retry-After: 86400, where at most 60000 is expected. client.ts accepts any digits, and query-client.ts queryRetryDelay waits retryAfterMs plus up to as much again, with no ceiling. A proxy's long Retry-After would leave a first load spinning for days with no error and no Retry. A value over about 1,073,741 s goes past setTimeout's 2^31-1 ms limit; [inference] browsers then fire the timer at once. Command: cd packages/dispatch && bun test web/src/api/query-client.test.ts. The 60 s ceiling is my choice of a value a person would accept; the implementer may choose a lower one.
